description: Every 508 automation in one place, with its current state. Switch any of them off here if something misbehaves.

fields.label: Learn Bank Rules Automatically
fields.description: Hourly, learn recurring expense/income categories from independent reconciled history. Learned suggestions never authorize automatic booking.

fields.label: Book Approved Bank Rules Automatically
fields.description: Hourly, book only eligible bank lines using individually authorized rules with fixed amount limits. Turn this off to stop automatic booking.

fields.label: Bank Automation User
fields.description: Enabled ERP user with Accounts Manager or System Manager role. All scheduled bank work runs with this user's record permissions.
Email a client invoice, with its PDF, when a Billing Approver submits it (including through a Billing Run). Anyone can still send one with the Email Invoice button.
fields.label: Email Invoices on Approval

fields.description: Used unless the customer has its own Invoice Print Format. Leave empty to use ERPNext's standard layout.
fields.label: Default Print Format

fields.description: Used instead of the default when the invoice includes timesheet hours. Leave empty to use the configured default, or ERPNext's standard layout when neither is configured.
fields.label: Print Format for Timesheet Invoices

fields.description: Copied on every invoice email, separated by commas or new lines.
fields.label: Always CC

fields.label: Email Subject

fields.default:
Hello,

Please find attached invoice {{ doc.name }} from 508.dev for {{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(doc.grand_total, currency=doc.currency) }}, due {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.due_date) }}.

Payment details are on the invoice. Please include the invoice number {{ doc.name }} in your payment reference so we can match it.

fields.description: When a Billing Run is approved, engineer and referral bills are put on hold (ERPNext blocks paying them) until the client pays the invoice for that work. Unblock a bill by hand to pay it earlier.
fields.label: Hold Engineer Bills Until the Client Pays

fields.description: Release held bills automatically once their client invoice is fully paid (checked after every payment and hourly).
fields.label: Release Holds When the Client Pays
Maximum Bank Balance Age (Hours)
fields.description: Payout approval requires bank-verified balance evidence newer than this. This app does not provide a live bank feed.

fields.label: Entry checks (erp_rules)
fields.description: Warnings and blocks shown while entering documents. Unticking one switches it off immediately for everyone.
Blocks submitting a sales invoice with a discount and no reason.
fields.label: Discount needs a reason

fields.description: Warns when hourly work is entered as one lump sum.
fields.label: Hours as quantity

fields.description: Warns when a sales invoice is due in under 29 days.
fields.label: Sales invoice due date

fields.description: Blocks payments and journal entries using a Cash account.

fields.description: Blocks a second payment of the same amount to the same party within a week.

fields.description: Warns when paying an engineer whose client hasn't paid.
fields.label: Client paid first

fields.description: Who gets the Monday digest, separated by commas or new lines. Empty switches it off. It lists every party's balances and payouts.
